messages:
Talia (docs): Heads-up: We're changing the default telemetry setting in SDKs: starting next release the SDKs will ship with telemetry opt-out by default for new installs. Existing installs remain unchanged. Migration doc: https://redwood.example.com/docs/sdk/telemetry-optin

Noah (eng): Clarify: new installs will opt-out by default (no telemetry) and users must opt-in explicitly?

Talia (docs): Correct. Rationale: privacy-first defaults and matching enterprise expectations. We will include an unobtrusive onboarding prompt in the Quickstart that explains the opt-in and links to the telemetry policy.

Sam (privacy): Agree with the default change. Need to ensure the SDKs log nothing PII and that the telemetry opt-in flow clearly states what is sent. I'll add a short spec and example payloads to the docs.

June (release): Timeline: we'll land the change in the next minor (SDKs + CLI) and coordinate console banner + changelog. Target publish next Tuesday.

QA-bot: CI note: examples/* include tests that assert telemetry is enabled by default; opening PRs to make tests explicit about opt-in behavior.

Noah (eng): Implementation notes: added env var REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=opt_in_by_user and a programmatic flag client.enableTelemetry({ optIn: true }). Default for new installs will be false. We'll keep a compatibility build tag so internal teams can opt back to old behavior during migration.

Talia (docs): Migration snippet for users who rely on old default:

```python
# explicit opt-in
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.enable_telemetry(opt_in=True)
```

Talia (docs): Plan checklist: 1) docs page + FAQ updated (done), 2) Quickstart onboarding prompt added (PR open), 3) changelog entry and console banner scheduled (June), 4) targeted email to enterprise customers with privacy controls info.

Sam (privacy): I'll review the onboarding copy and the telemetry spec today. If any telemetry payloads need redaction, flag them now.

June (release): I'll include the change in release notes and coordinate the console banner. If any customer issues, tag @June (release) and @Noah (eng) for fast rollbacks.

docs-bot: changelog entry created -> https://redwood.example.com/changelog/telemetry-default-change (created by Talia (docs)).

Talia (docs): Closing thread. DM me for tenant-specific rollout details or the enterprise opt-in API guide.
